title: Transparent style box applies transparency to children when Clip Children is enabled
body:
### Tested versions

Occurs in v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

Also confirmed broken in v4.1.1.stable.official [bd6af8e0e]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+, Also compatibility and Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.13031.3015) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads)

### Issue description

Any Control node which has a style box (Panel, Button, etc.) will apply it's stylebox's transparency to it's children if clip-children is set to either clip only or clip and draw. If clip-children is disabled or if you use a StyleBoxEmpty, the children will not be made transparent. Since the default stylebox in the engine is partially transparent, 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project.
2. Create any Control which has a StyleBox. In my example, I use Panels.
3. The default StyleBox provided by the engine is already partially transparent, but a new StyleBox can also be added via Theme Overrides.
4. Set `clip_children` to any non-disabled value. In my example, I use "Clip + Draw"
5. Add any CanvasItem child. Control and Node2D are both affected.

The child will inherit the same transparency as the clipping parent's style-box. Adjusting the style box will change the child in real time.

My MRP contains a single scene `main.tscn` and includes 3 Panels with children and various configurations:

- All contain a child TextureRect while the first Panel also includes a Sprite2D just to show it affects them too. 
- The first panel has clipping enabled and the engine-default StyleBox, which is already transparent.
- The second panel has clipping enabled, but uses an opaque StyleBox via Theme Overrides.
- The last panel has the default StyleBox, but with clipping disabled.
- Some labels are provided as well as a white bar which serves as a background object just to really show what is and isn't transparent.

The MRP looks like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bcce4659-1a13-401b-8d1d-3734ff21b5ed)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[stylebox_clipping_transparency_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20851496/stylebox_clipping_transparency_bug.zip)
